why.text: server.public-url = 'no legal copy' is https, so a reverse proxy serves it, and auth.trusted-networks trusts loopback, where a proxy on this machine connects from — declare the proxy by listing loopback in auth.proxy-networks (what it forwards then needs auth.api-key), or take loopback out of auth.trusted-networks
server.host lists 'a' and 'b' on one port, but 'a' already listens on every address of this computer — list 'a' alone, or only specific addresses (HISTMERSION_BIND)
